subject: Escalation: bundled onboarding + premium support concession request (Reef Medical)
messages:
From: Erin Clarke <erin.clarke@reefmedical.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood proposal — need bundled onboarding + premium support details (urgent)

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Reef Medical is keen to move forward but we need a firm offer that includes: a dedicated onboarding program with API connector work to our EHR, premium support for our pilot cohort (24/7 incident channel + 15-min P1 SLA), and a 12-month commitment.

Our procurement team is also asking for any one-time onboarding credits you can extend — we have internal budget constraints and a tight go-live window (Q4). Can you confirm whether the onboarding engineering scope you shared is billable, and whether Redwood can bundle the premium support into the committed price (we were hoping for a concession on professional services)?

I'm attaching our security questionnaire and a short technical contact list. Happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Best,
Erin Clarke
Head of Digital Product
Reef Medical

Attachments: security_questionnaire_filled.pdf
From: logan.wright@redwood.com
To: Erin Clarke <erin.clarke@reefmedical.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal — need bundled onboarding + premium support details (urgent)

Hi Erin —

Appreciate the clear asks. We're excited to partner with Reef. Quick notes:
- Onboarding: the connector to your EHR is scoped as professional services (estimated 120 engineer-hours in the SOW).
- Premium support: can be bundled for the term, but pricing varies by response SLA and seat count.
- Onboarding credit: I can request a one-time credit against PS but will need approval from my manager and RevOps.

Marissa and Naomi — looping you in to evaluate possible concession sizing and technical deliverables. Naomi, can you review the attached technical items and confirm the 120-hr estimate?

Erin — I'll escalate today and aim to come back with a proposal and an executive approval ask by tomorrow EOD.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
loganw@redwood.com
Office: +1 415-555-0192
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: logan.wright@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-15T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Redwood proposal — need bundled onboarding + premium support details (urgent)

Logan —

I reviewed the ask. Quick commercial read: Reef is a strategic late-stage pilot (healthcare) — potential for multi-region expansion. We can make a concession but this is outside standard PS bundled discounting. Suggested path for Deal Desk / Exec approval:

1) Offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to 30% of the PS line (applied as a credit on first invoice) OR a capped 80 hours free (whichever is lower).
2) Bundle premium support at a reduced rate for the first 6 months (20% reduction off published premium price) — then standard pricing after the initial term.
3) Require a 12-month committed license (hosted API) and a minimum monthly usage estimate in the MSA.

If finance/RevOps pushes back, we could trade lower credit for a larger committed ARR. Need exec signoff for anything >= 25% discount or PS credit above $40k.

Aditya — please run margin impact and confirm whether a 25% concession on total annual contract value keeps us above target margin. Rafael — if you can weigh in with approval band given strategic value, that'll speed things up.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Mid-Market
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, logan.wright@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-15T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal — need bundled onboarding + premium support details (urgent)

Marissa / Logan —

Technical confirmation after reviewing Reef's materials:
- EHR connector: 100-140 engineer-hours depending on data-mapping edge cases. I recommend we budget 130 hrs and treat any scope creep as a formally scopped change order.
- Security questionnaire: most items straightforward; they asked for access logs retention policy and we can provide a standard SOC2 artifact.
- Support: to deliver a 15-min P1 SLA we need a staffed 24/7 rotation for the pilot months — that's billable. The 6-month reduced-rate bundle is feasible if we limit the included incidents to operational triage and non-engineering remediation (engineering work would be scoped separately).

I've uploaded a draft SOW with redlines (reef_sow_v1.pdf). Putting the recommended PS estimate in the Drive link.

Naomi Feldman
Director, Customer Success
From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, logan.wright@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-16T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Redwood proposal — need bundled onboarding + premium support details (urgent)

Team — margin check complete:
- Baseline proposal (no concessions): ARR $420k, PS $72k (130 hrs * blended rate).
- Impact of Marissa's suggested concession (30% PS credit up to $40k, 20% off premium support first 6 months): gross margin would drop ~8 points in year one but acceptable with multi-year renewal probability >60%.
- If we approve a 25% total concession on ACV, we need an executive uplift to keep quota crediting consistent for the AE.

Requesting Rafael's explicit approval for: 1) up to $40k onboarding credit, 2) 20% premium-support concession for 6 months, 3) 12-month committed license (minimum).

Aditya Rao
Revenue Operations
From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, logan.wright@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-16T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: APPROVED (conditional) — Reef Medical concession request

Team — after quick review I approve the following, conditional on execution of a 12-month MSA and a documented usage forecast:

1) One-time onboarding credit capped at $35,000 applied to the initial invoice (note: lower than Marissa's ask to limit margin hit).
2) Premium support bundled at 20% off list for the first 6 months; after that standard published rates apply. Support coverage will be limited to operational triage and runbook-driven remediation; any engineering work billed separately.
3) PS scope budgeted at 130 hours; changes require a signed change order.

Logan — please update the commercial redline with these limits, include the usage forecast requirement in the SOW, and route the final MSA to legal for expedited review. Erin — we'll send a formal offer with these concessions within 24 hours.

-Rafael Mendes
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
